General-content county map also showing rural buildings and householders' names. Hand col. to distinguish townships and village insets. "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1865 by Tuttle & Co. in the ... Eastern District of Penna." LC copies imperfect: Copy 1 halved to enable folding, trimmed; copy 2 fold-lined, torn at edges, section of Waynesburg inset torn away. Includes ill. of J.L. McConnell. Town/village insets (with householders' names): Jefferson, Jefferson Township -- Waynesburg, county town -- Carmichaels, Cumberland Township -- Greensboro, Monongahela Township -- Clarksville, Morgan Township -- Jacksonville, Rich Hill Township -- Morrisville, Franklin Township -- New Town, Whiteley Township -- Mount Morris, Perry Township -- Davis Town, Dunkard Township -- Rice's Landing, Jefferson Township -- Maple Town, Monongahela Township -- Fairview, Dunkard Township -- Garard's Fort, Greene Township.
